title: A file of config/templates/ and the operator's templates/
description: The notification texts of one language, `config/templates/<language>.yaml` (views.md, "Files for people", D-471, D-472; F-140 D2): a template name to a Mustache template. The names are those that `notify` boxes give as `template`, and the alert kinds, as `<kind>` or `<kind>.<reason>`. The operator's file of the same name is patched over the shop's, and an operator file with a new name adds a language.
